math.generalArgument: For every positive n, unique quotient/remainder blocks exhaust the printed strict interval, and coprime residues pair to D. Their contribution is n times a linear block expression plus the triangular-index sum; resulting positive quadratic and linear coefficients match every printed answer. No outside-grade method is turned into a student method merely because this reviewer verifies it.
math.existenceUniqueness: For each supported fixed composite D and positive n, finitely many natural a lie in the strict interval; filtering gcd(a,D)=1 uniquely determines the set and sum. n=1 remains valid; residue0 and integer endpoints are excluded. Positive coefficient rules out cancellation of the quadratic term.
